# Fincado

> Free financial calculators and plain-language guides for India: income tax (FY 2026-27, Income Tax Act 2025), salary in-hand, loan EMI, SIP, PPF, EPF, NPS and retirement. Available in English and Hindi. Calculations follow official slabs and rules, with assumptions stated on each page.

Fincado is written and maintained by Nitin Kaushik. Editorial policy: https://fincado.com/editorial-guidelines/ . Figures are estimates for planning, not tax or investment advice.

## Calculators

- [Income Tax Calculator FY 2026-27](https://fincado.com/income-tax-calculator/): Old vs new regime under the Income Tax Act 2025
- [Salary (In-Hand) Calculator](https://fincado.com/salary-calculator/): CTC to monthly take-home
- [EMI Calculator](https://fincado.com/emi-calculator/): Home, car and personal loan EMI with amortisation
- [Home Loan Calculator](https://fincado.com/home-loan-calculator/)
- [SIP Calculator](https://fincado.com/sip-calculator/)
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://fincado.com/lumpsum-calculator/)
- [PPF Calculator](https://fincado.com/ppf-calculator/)
- [EPF Calculator](https://fincado.com/epf-calculator/)
- [NPS Calculator](https://fincado.com/nps-calculator/)
- [FD Calculator](https://fincado.com/fd-calculator/)
- [RD Calculator](https://fincado.com/rd-calculator/)
